standards.name: JERM Ontology (Just Enough Results Model)
standards.abstract: JERM is an OWL ontology intended to describe metadata for systems and synthetic biology investigations — for example, experimental samples (organisms, strains), experimental factors (media, pH, temperature), data files and formats, and model- or experiment-level descriptions. The standard provides a structured vocabulary (classes, data properties, and object properties) for annotating the ‘just enough’ descriptive information needed to interpret, reuse and reproduce experiments and models. The ontology is distributed as an OWL file and is maintained by the JERM authors (Katy Wolstencroft and contributors) and referenced by FAIRDOM/SEEK resources to improve metadata consistency and interoperability.

classification.rationale: The source material is an OWL ontology file that lists concrete declarations of Classes, DataProperty and ObjectProperty IRIs. This is a structured vocabulary — effectively a metadata schema with named terms — and therefore aligns with a table-like extraction of named fields/terms (classes and properties) each having a clear identity and expected data role (ontology_term, string, URI, reference).

Organism.name: Organism
Organism.descr: Ontology class representing an organism entity used in experiments or samples.

Project.name: Project
Project.descr: Ontology class representing a project grouping experiments or data.

Data.name: Data
Data.descr: Ontology class representing data produced by experiments or models.

Format.name: Format
Format.descr: Ontology class representing a data or file format.

Publication.name: Publication
Publication.descr: Ontology class representing a publication associated with data or a project.

Strain.name: Strain
Strain.descr: Ontology class representing a biological strain.

labInternalID.name: labInternalID
labInternalID.descr: Data property for an internal laboratory identifier.

description.name: description
description.descr: Data property intended to hold textual descriptions.

webLink.name: webLink
webLink.descr: Data property for a web link / URL related to the entity.

hasItem.name: hasItem
hasItem.descr: Object property linking an entity to items it contains or references.

isPartOf.name: isPartOf
isPartOf.descr: Object property indicating membership / part-of relationships.

isFormatOf.name: isFormatOf
isFormatOf.descr: Object property linking a Format to the entity it is a format of.

standards.notes: Extraction focused on representative classes and properties declared in the JERM OWL source. The OWL file contains many additional class and property declarations that can be added if a more exhaustive extraction is required.
